note: YouTube signal for the social-media agent. Reads the curated channel list (channels.json, seeded from the reader's subscriptions) and fetches each channel's RSS feed (youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml) — stable, no auth, no yt-dlp. Captures recent videos + views + rating + description for the ranker/synthesis. Robust: RSS is a stable interface; failures per-channel are skipped. Output raw/youtube/ (public — channel content, not a personal algorithmic feed).
